abstract: Numerous disorders are known to cause sexual precocity. Beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG)-secreting germ-cell tumors are one of the sources that have to be considered in the differential diagnosis of processes inducing a peripheral precocious puberty. Germ-cell tumors might be located in the ovaries or testes, retroperitoneum, mediastinum or the cranium. We present the case of a 9-year-old boy with sexual precocity and a recurrent transient beta-HCG elevation. After an interval of 2 years with repeated radiological examinations including the mediastinum, a mediastinal tumor was identified by magnetic resonance imaging. To our knowledge, this is the first case of a diagnosis of a mediastinal choriocarcinoma with a recurrent serum beta-HCG elevation. So far, factors that might be responsible for the repeated spontaneous beta-HCG decline are unknown.
abstract_ja: 思春期早発症は多くの疾患によって生じます。β-hCG産生胚細胞腫瘍は、末梢性思春期早発症の鑑別診断において考慮すべき病態の一つです。胚細胞腫瘍は卵巣や精巣、後腹膜、縦隔、頭蓋内に発生することがあります。本稿では、思春期早発症と再発性の一過性β-hCG上昇を呈した9歳男児の症例を報告します。2年間にわたり縦隔を含む画像検査を繰り返し施行した後、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により縦隔腫瘍が同定されました。我々の知る限り、再発性の血清β-hCG上昇を伴う縦隔絨毛癌の診断例は本例が初めてです。繰り返される自然なβ-hCG低下の原因となる因子は、現在のところ不明です。
